description: The bar chart titled "Recall@10" compares the performance of different methods in terms of recall at 10. The vertical axis represents recall values, ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, while the horizontal axis lists four methods: "Ours," "Critiquing," "Scoring," and "Ranking." The "Ours" method, represented by an orange bar, has the highest recall value, approximately 0.4. The "Critiquing" method, shown in blue, has a recall value around 0.3. The "Scoring" method has a significantly lower recall value, close to 0.1, and the "Ranking" method has a recall value slightly above 0.2. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized.
